name: US Series Lead-free Wave Soldering System

items: The movement of the nozzle realizes dual-axis linkage in the X.Y direction, and is driven by a stepping motor, with accurate positioning. The programming control method is flexible, which can meet the complex process requirements, such as partial secondary spraying, partial continuous spraying, etc.;

Free combination of hot air and infrared preheating modules (3-stage preheating): When preheating PCB products with different process requirements, any combination of preheating methods can be used to improve the preheating ability;
New tin furnace and crest nozzle design: Adjustable tin wave drop design, effectively reducing tin dross generation;

The maximum transport capacity of the guide rail is 60KG: The innovative transportation chain assembly structure and support method provide more stable transportation speed and higher transportation carrying capacity;
The cooling system adopts the upper and lower blowing structure design, and the cooling efficiency is flexibly controlled.
